name: COMSOL
desc: Develops COMSOL Multiphysics, simulation and computer-aided engineering software used to model interacting physical effects in engineering design.
capacity_detail: Official Multiphysics Partner of the ABB FIA Formula E World Championship under a multi-year partnership announced 7 Oct 2026
sponsorships: Formula E official multiphysics partner (multi-year, from Oct 2026)
markets: Software sold worldwide through the COMSOL Group's 16 offices plus a distributor network; 700+ employees globally
rationale: Already sponsoring Formula E; F1 teams are heavy simulation users and rival Ansys (Synopsys) is an F1 partner, so technical-partner status fits.

name: Stalwart Law Group
desc: California plaintiff law firm specialising in medical malpractice, birth injury, catastrophic injury and wrongful death litigation, founded in 2016.
capacity_detail: Named official law firm of the NFL's Los Angeles Chargers under a multiyear partnership announced 11 Nov 2026
sponsorships: Los Angeles Chargers official law firm (NFL, multiyear, Nov 2026)
markets: California; offices in Los Angeles and Orange County; says it has recovered more than USD 500 million for clients

signals.marketing: Became official law firm of the Los Angeles Chargers (Nov 2026; https://www.chargers.com/news/stalwart-law-group-official-law-firm-multiyear-partnership)

rationale: Local consumer-facing law firm now buying NFL rights; an F1 deal is unlikely beyond Las Vegas Grand Prix hospitality-style activation.
